title: agents/langgraph.md cites the PyPI project JSON for a pip install form the JSON does not state
goal: kb/public/agents/langgraph.md's install facts (lines 13 and 35) state only what their cited source says: S-v5hqqcqx (https://pypi.org/pypi/langgraph/json) gives version 1.2.14, MIT and the README's 'uv add langgraph', not 'pip install langgraph'; the pip form is dropped or cited to a page that states it, and the facts are re-anchored with factdiff.py anchor --quotes

run: import re,sys;t=open('kb/public/agents/langgraph.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(1 if re.search(r'pip install[^\[]*\[DOC S-v5hqqcqx\]',t) else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is a fact's wording against its cited page; a command can only read the fact text, and the fix is checked by reading it against the live page
